azureRanking.title: DevOps Champions
azureRanking.scoringSystemHint: How points are awarded and levels are reached
azureRanking.patHint: Never shown again for security reasons – please re-enter it when changing settings.
azureRanking.perWeekExplain: Points divided by the weeks with at least one counted activity – evens out vacation, part-time work and joining later.
azureRanking.perWeekOnlyPoints: “Per active week” only applies to Overall and Combined – this category is sorted by count.
azureRanking.howCountedHint: Points per action, caps, fairness rules and levels

fairness.once: Completed work items count exactly once – at the actual transition to Done/Closed, for the person assigned at that moment. Later changes (board, tags, area path …) don't count again.
fairness.weights: PBIs/bugs count more than tasks; features, epics and test artifacts don't count as completed work.
fairness.reviews: A PR counts as reviewed as soon as you vote or comment; “Approved with suggestions” counts as an approval; your own PRs don't count.
fairness.caps: Caps against sheer volume: max. {{prComments}} findings and {{replies}} replies per PR, max. {{tickets}} created tickets and {{tasks}} tasks per day, ticket comments once per ticket and day.
fairness.identities: Bots, service accounts and team groups are ignored; accounts with identical names are merged.
fairness.perWeek: “Per active week” evens out vacation, part-time work and joining later.
fairness.recalc: Whenever the logic changes, the entire history is recalculated automatically.
fairness.reviewDepth: Review depth counts: every new finding (its own thread) earns points, replies in the discussion a little less. Pure acknowledgements (“ok”, “done”, “LGTM”, “thanks”) and comments under {{minLength}} characters don't count.
fairness.ports: Backports don't count as a new PR: a PR with the same title in the same repository but for another target branch within {{portDays}} days only earns the backport points.

azureRanking.outdatedHint: New evaluation logic – please refresh once to see the corrected values.
azureRanking.rebuildHint: Reloads the complete history from Azure DevOps and recalculates all values. Usually not needed – “Refresh” only loads new events and takes a few seconds. Useful if values look implausible or data in Azure DevOps was changed retroactively.
azureRanking.rebuildBusy: A refresh is currently running – please wait until it has finished.
azureRanking.rebuildConfirmText: All events are reloaded from Azure DevOps and the entire history is recalculated. This takes about 2 minutes.
azureRanking.rebuildConfirmNote: The current values stay visible until it has finished; progress is shown at the top of the page.
azureRanking.rebuildStarted: Full rebuild started – takes about 2 minutes
azureRanking.activeWeeksHint: Weeks with at least one counted activity in the period
